name: NH Madrid Ribera del Manzanares
description: The NH Madrid Ribera del Manzanares hotel is set in a peaceful area of Madrid and overlooks the green and luscious Manzanares River gardens. You will find the Royal Palace and the Almudena Cathedral nearby. For business travelers, the Casa de Campo fairgrounds are also close to the hotel, and the M30 highway provides easy access by car. There are 224 rooms at NH Madrid Ribera del Manzanares, each with a flat screen TV and free Wi-Fi. Your sleep won't be disturbed thanks to the soundproof windows and comfy mattresses, while the warm neutral colors and hardwood floors will help you relax. Some of the rooms offer lovely views of the river and the Royal Palace. Enjoy our daily fresh breakfast, with cold cuts, cheeses, eggs cooked-to-order, and fresh pastries. Mediterranean and Spanish dishes are available at the La Ribera restaurant and can be enjoyed on our sunny terrace, along with drinks and snacks. There is also a bar at the hotel. Get the most out of your relaxing stay by heading to the gym, outdorr pool in the summer months, or making use of our massage services. For transportation, we have parking, e-bikes for rent and electric car chargers.
